title: Relative roughness and Reynolds-number conditions
readable: relative roughness (k/D); Reynolds number greater than 10^7; normal range 4,000 to 10^6
applicability: For Reynolds number greater than 10^7, friction factor f (and hence C-value) is relatively independent of diameter and velocity. For normal ranges 4,000 to 10^6, f (and hence C-value) depends on diameter, velocity and relative roughness.
